product_metadata.title: Home-X Acrylic Eyeglass Holder
features: Multi-purpose Acrylic Holder. Elegant storage for makeup to eyeglasses!
A sculptural work of art to enhance any spot, and organize everything from writing essentials to makeup brushes, reading glasses to craft markers.
This crystal-clear solid acrylic holder has the clean lines of Art Deco, and complements all décors.

Stands sturdily on a shelf, counter or desktop and accepts a variety of items for beautiful organization. Terrific for things that roll around, fall off or magically disappear – for bathroom, kitchen, office or hobby nook.
